query_contract: Only exact manifest argv for standard installed read-only tools. No untrusted file or script is executed. Utility provenance is not promoted to product qualification. One final owned-only ps PID/PPID/PGID/state snapshot; no process argv/environment. Docker uses an explicit fixed unix:///var/run/docker.sock endpoint; HOME/current context cannot select a remote endpoint. An absent or refused socket remains a failed finite query with no fallback.
absence_contract: Every entry remains in the denominator. Only a leaf's own before/after ENOENT under a verified held parent is reported absent. An unavailable, missing or symlink ancestor leaves each descendant blocked and the observation incomplete; no child absence is inferred. Symlinks are never followed; unreadable/refused paths are not absence.
